boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-purchase outings on campus and around Milledgeville, including trails, gardens, archives, historic sites, and a free walking tour.

cards.title: Browse Milledgeville History Together
cards.subtitle: Archives and exhibits inside Ina Dillard Russell Library
cards.notes: Visit on a weekday to explore regional history exhibits, university archives, and the Usery Leadership Gallery without paying admission.
cards.short_summary: A free indoor history stop featuring university and community collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia’s official tourism site lists Heritage Hall admission as $0 and identifies its galleries, special collections, and museum education room.
cards.access_notes: Open to visitors Monday through Friday; consult the destination page for current daily hours before going.

cards.title: Picnic and Walk the Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Gardens, meadow, pond, and nature trails on 50 acres
cards.notes: Bring a picnic, follow the nature trails, or walk the main grounds; skip the separately priced Rose Hill house tour to keep the outing free.
cards.short_summary: Free public gardens and trails with space for an unhurried group picnic.
cards.evidence_claim: Lockerly Arboretum states that it is free and open to the public and that visitors may walk or drive the grounds, hike trails, or picnic at no charge.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are open Monday–Friday, with seasonal Saturday hours; Rose Hill tours cost extra and are not part of this activity.

cards.title: Take a Riverside Walk
cards.subtitle: Nearly three miles of paths, boardwalks, and open green space
cards.notes: Meet at the Greenway for a walk, jog, bike ride, or picnic beside the Oconee River; use the observation areas for a group pause.
cards.short_summary: A flexible riverside hang with paved paths, boardwalks, and picnic space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Milledgeville-Baldwin County tourism bureau describes the Greenway’s walking, jogging, biking, fishing, and picnic amenities and lists free parking.
cards.access_notes: Open seven days a week from sunrise to sunset; equipment rentals are optional and not included in this free activity.

cards.title: Watch the Lake from the Pier
cards.subtitle: Public floating docks and picnic tables at Lake Sinclair
cards.notes: Gather on the docks for lake views or bring your own legal fishing gear; the shoreline access and picnic tables make lingering easy.
cards.short_summary: A free lakeside meetup on public docks with fishing and picnic access.
cards.evidence_claim: Milledgeville’s tourism bureau says the Georgia Power-maintained T. D. Cheek Fishing Pier is open year-round and free to the public.
cards.source_title: Top Free Things to Do in Milledgeville, Georgia
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; fishing requires participants to supply gear and follow applicable Georgia licensing rules.

cards.title: Follow the Historic Walking Tour
cards.subtitle: A self-guided route through downtown Milledgeville
cards.notes: Pick up the complimentary guide at the Visitor Center, then walk the route together and compare the architectural details it identifies.
cards.short_summary: A free, self-paced downtown walk guided by a complimentary printed brochure.
cards.evidence_claim: The local tourism bureau directs visitors to collect a free Historic Walking Tour guide covering Milledgeville’s historic homes and landmarks.
cards.source_title: Top Free Things to Do in Milledgeville, Georgia
cards.access_notes: Collect the free guide during Visitor Information Center hours; the outdoor route itself is self-guided.

cards.title: Plan an Outing Over Free Wi-Fi
cards.subtitle: Maps, brochures, seating, and visitor assistance downtown
cards.notes: Meet inside to compare maps and build a walking plan using the free Wi-Fi; ask staff about accessible routes before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A no-purchase planning meetup with free connectivity and local route information.
cards.evidence_claim: The Milledgeville Visitor Information Center states that free Wi-Fi is available throughout its building and that it provides maps and brochures.
cards.access_notes: Use during posted Visitor Center hours; the building has an accessible rear ramp and accessible restrooms.

cards.title: Hike the West Campus Trails
cards.subtitle: A free trail outing on Georgia College’s West Campus
cards.notes: Choose a daylight loop and hike with a friend; students can reach West Campus by car or use the university bus from Front Campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-adjacent trail walk that requires neither admission nor a purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: The Milledgeville tourism bureau’s campus guide says the West Campus trails can be hiked at any time for free and notes car and campus-bus access.
cards.source_title: Sites to Visit on Georgia College’s Campus
cards.access_notes: Use established trails during daylight and check university notices for temporary closures or transportation changes.

cards.entity_name: Andalusia: The Home of Flannery O’Connor
cards.title: Tour Andalusia with Your Bobcat ID
cards.subtitle: Free house admission for current GCSU students
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, join an hourly house tour, then walk the grounds at your own pace during the property’s operating hours.
cards.short_summary: A student-free literary history outing at Flannery O’Connor’s former home.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia College’s Andalusia page states that admission is free for all GCSU students, faculty, and staff and publishes its tour schedule.
cards.access_notes: Free admission is limited to GCSU students, faculty, and staff; bring university identification. The historic house is not ADA accessible.

cards.title: Join a Free Student House Tour
cards.subtitle: Local education and Black history on South Clarke Street
cards.notes: Bring your Bobcat ID and arrive before the top of an operating hour for a guided look at educator Sallie Ellis Davis’s former home.
cards.short_summary: A free-to-GCSU-students guided visit centered on a notable Milledgeville educator.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia College states that Sallie Ellis Davis House admission is free for Georgia College students, faculty, and staff and lists guided-tour times.
cards.source_title: Tour Information – Sallie Ellis Davis House
cards.access_notes: Free admission is limited to Georgia College students, faculty, and staff; tours run only on listed Wednesdays, Fridays, and selected weekends.

cards.title: Loop Around Tobler Creek
cards.subtitle: A three-quarter-mile woodland trail on the Andalusia grounds
cards.notes: Walk the leaf-covered loop with friends, watch for wildlife around the pond and fields, and return before the property gates close.
cards.short_summary: A short free nature loop through woods and fields on Andalusia’s grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Milledgeville tourism bureau identifies Tobler Creek Trail as a three-quarter-mile loop and says Andalusia’s grounds are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Go Outside in Milledgeville | Lockerly Arboretum & Bartram Forest
cards.access_notes: Use only during Andalusia’s posted Tuesday–Sunday operating hours; property gates close after the final tour.
